perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: September 18 FDA full approval of Inluriyo plus Verzenio remains the newest material Lilly primary disclosure in cumulative evidence, converting Phase 3 evidence into a commercializable oncology combination.
September 15 EASD preview adds near-term cardiometabolic readout visibility, but scheduled presentations remain evidence-to-come rather than realized execution.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Approval is a real regulatory execution conversion; commercial contribution still depends on uptake, eligible population, reimbursement and competitive positioning.
Upcoming EASD data should not be pre-counted before actual data are released and interpreted.

lineage.searchStrategy: cumulative evidence reuse; pending data not treated as realized evidence
